summary.title: Angular 5 To-Do List App - Part 1
summary.one_liner: You learn how to set up Bootstrap 3 in an Angular 5 project and build the first version of a to-do list with ngFor, a clear button, and a table layout.
keywords: build a todo app with angular
takeaways: Install Bootstrap 3 with npm and add its minified CSS to the styles array in .angular-cli.json.
Clean up a starter Angular project by clearing the root component's template, styles, and class body.
Use *ngFor to render a string array of to-do items inside an HTML table.
Wire a Bootstrap danger button to a component method with (click) to clear the list using splice(0).
Structure the table with thead, tbody and tfoot, placing the clear button in tfoot.
summary.summary: This DiscoverSDK tutorial is the first part of a series building a to-do list app in Angular 5. It explains why Bootstrap 3 CSS (without its jQuery-dependent JavaScript) is added via npm and the .angular-cli.json styles array, then resets the starter project. The author builds the UI step by step: a Bootstrap grid container and striped table, a string array in the component populated with *ngFor, and a Clear button bound to a clearToDo() method. The code is also available in the author's GitHub repository, and later parts will add functionality.
